name: Defeat Nek'rosh
summary: In the Wetlands, the Alliance campaign against the Dragonmaw reaches its final strike. With their siege engines sabotaged, the defenders turn on Chieftain Nek'rosh to secure Menethil Harbor. His severed head must be brought to Captain Stoutfist to break the threat to the coastal port.

sections.title: Decapitating the Dragonmaw
sections.body: The Dragonmaw have long plagued the marshlands of Khaz Modan, entrenched in fortified camps and threatening Menethil Harbor's sea lanes. After discovering and burning the clan's catapults, the marsh's defenders strike at the warband's leader. Chieftain Nek'rosh commands the local orcs and remains the last obstacle to breaking the siege. His death leaves the remaining raiders without their leader's direction.

sections.title: Securing the Harbor
sections.body: Bring Nek'rosh's severed head to Captain Stoutfist in Menethil Harbor, and Ironforge's garrison will claim a major victory. Without their heavy siege weapons or their chieftain, the Dragonmaw suffer a blow they are unlikely to recover from quickly. Menethil Harbor is the Alliance's main lifeline between Lordaeron and Khaz Modan. With Nek'rosh fallen, the port's docks and trade vessels are safer from sudden attack.

faq.answer: Nek'rosh leads the remaining Dragonmaw in the Wetlands. From their camps, he organized an assault on Menethil Harbor with siege catapults before the Alliance struck back.

faq.q: Why does Menethil Harbor want Nek'rosh dead?
faq.answer: Nek'rosh threatens Menethil Harbor directly. Under his command, the Dragonmaw built war catapults to bombard the port and cripple the vital shipping lanes linking Khaz Modan to other Alliance lands.

faq.q: Who orders the death of Nek'rosh?
aliases: where to turn in nekrosh head
faq.answer: The order to strike comes after the Dragonmaw catapults are set on fire. Captain Stoutfist, who commands Menethil Harbor's defense, receives the chieftain's severed head.

faq.q: What happens to the Dragonmaw clan after Nek'rosh is defeated?
faq.answer: With their catapults destroyed and their chieftain slain, the Dragonmaw lose leadership and morale. Stragglers still haunt the marshlands, but their immediate campaign against Menethil Harbor is crushed.

faq.q: What is the Dragonmaw clan doing in the Wetlands?
faq.answer: The Dragonmaw settled in the Wetlands and the neighboring highlands of Grim Batol during the Second War. After the Horde's defeat, renegade remnants lingered in the swamps, raiding trade routes and harboring deep hatred for the Alliance and the dwarves of Khaz Modan.

faq.q: Why is Menethil Harbor so crucial to the Alliance?
faq.answer: Menethil Harbor is Ironforge's only major seaport on the western coast. Its ferries carry troops, trade goods, and travelers across the Great Sea to Kalimdor and north toward Lordaeron.

angles.text: As a dwarf of Khaz Modan, you know the Dragonmaw as a lingering scar on your people's ancestral borders. Defeating Nek'rosh protects dwarven roads and Ironforge's western sea trade.
As an Alliance member, you depend on Menethil Harbor's sea route linking Ironforge and Stormwind with Kalimdor and the northern waters.
As a warrior, you face Chieftain Nek'rosh in his fortified war camp, testing your martial grit against one of the marsh's fiercest orc commanders.
